name: Session Sweeper
description: Opt-in selective purger for stale site data. Data age is computed from the module's own last-interaction ledger (browser.history.onVisited per origin) because browsingData.remove({since}) deletes data NEWER than a timestamp and cannot enumerate per-origin ages. Stale origins are purged per-origin with no since cutoff; never for open tabs or allow-listed domains. First use is opt-in with a deletion preview.
